fusions.name: Garotte Thread
fusions.desc: Cinches fine filaments around a target at or below 25% health, dealing 16 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Binding Strand
fusions.desc: Wraps a sticky strand around the target, dealing 4 damage and slowing it by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mantle of Strands
fusions.desc: Weaves your arms into a mantle that raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand upon Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land lays a strand on the target, up to 6. When it reaches 6 they all spend at once as a burst of damage. Unfed, a strand frays every 4 seconds.
